company.name: TWAICE
company.shortDescription: TWAICE is a battery company developing analytics software that addresses the transparency and predictability of batteries.
company.description: TWAICE is a battery company developing analytics software that addresses the transparency and predictability of batteries. The company provides predictive analytics software that optimizes the development and operation of lithium-ion batteries. Its core technology is the digital twin - software that combines deep battery knowledge and artificial intelligence to determine the condition and predict the aging and performance of batteries. This makes complex battery systems more transparent, effective, and reliable.

aiResearchSummary.text: TWAICE is researching and developing methods for estimating battery state of charge, capacity, and health, as seen in titles like Estimation of calendar aging of battery cells and Calculation of effective state of charge. Their work includes hybrid parametric and machine learning models for battery aging, battery state estimation methods, and big data approaches for fault identification in battery systems. These areas focus on improving transparency and predictability in battery analytics.
